## ♿ Accessibility & UX Checklist / প্রবেশগম্যতা নির্দেশিকা

- [ ] Interactive elements have ARIA labels or visible accessible names
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and visible focus rings verified
- [ ] Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards
- [ ] Screen reader announcements tested for dynamic updates
- [ ] Bilingual text (Bengali & English) formatted correctly

---

## 🧪 Verification / যাচাইকরণ

- [ ] Tested locally with `pnpm test` (or relevant test command)
- [ ] Clean code formatting verified
